sloka: विश्वामित्रो अपि राजर्षिः हृष्ट पुष्टः तदा अभवत् ।स अन्तः पुर वरो राजा स ब्राह्मण पुरोहितः ॥१-५३-६॥
transliteration: viśvāmitro api rājarṣiḥ hṛṣṭa puṣṭaḥ tadā abhavat ।sa antaḥ pura varo rājā sa brāhmaṇa purohitaḥ ॥1-53-6॥

translations.english: King Viswamitra along with ladies, priests and brahmins including the royal sage were fully satisfied and delighted.
